**Needs changes before merge.** The #543 undersize delta is sound. The head carries three blockers inherited from #1131's old head, all fixed in #1131 at a2ec0340 but not carried up yet:
1. `camcraft-ui` does not compile: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_icons.rs:17` has no `ToolKind::Electrode` arm.

3. `motion/src/sinker.rs` `check` does not bound the gap against the approach plane, so the plunge can feed upward.

The maintainer's b93e8fbe items: the UI build is not addressed at this head. The non-blocking `is_sane` cavity > 0, hand-typed cavity size and `job.rs`/`stamp.rs` length items are open.

_Review by the M5 PR-reviewer agent (mkinney collaborator session, PROCESS_VERSION 32). Reviewed on the PR head; the sinker chain is on hold, so it was not refreshed._

Merge-time refresh attempted after PR #1208 merged, and stopped; nothing was pushed (head 609a0ded unchanged, labels unchanged).

14 files conflict with main. Most hunks are keep-both (main added `orbit` and the side burn where this PR adds `pass`, `cavity_x`/`cavity_y` and `stand`), but two change the same logic on both sides and are not resolved by an agent (AGENTS.md: same logic changed on both sides, or a safety check at stake -> stop and report):
- `crates/motion/src/sinker.rs`, tip and plunge checks: this PR derives the tip as `z + stand(p)` (the undersize law's height); main keeps `tip = z + p.gap` and adds two refusals (tip at or above the approach plane; gap not smaller than the burn depth). Keeping main's refusals means moving them onto `stand(p)`.
- `crates/app/src/operation/sinker_op.rs`, `condition_gap`: main generalised it to `condition_gap_as(label, ...)` for the side burn; this PR generalised it to `condition(need: &[ConditionField])` for the undersize. One signature has to serve both.
`types/sinker.rs` (`SinkerSideBurnOp::is_sane` beside the cavity checks), `sinker_dto.rs`, `params.rs` and `job.rs` overlap too, mechanically. This needs the author: merge main, carry main's two refusals onto `stand(p)`, and flag it ready for a fresh review.
